subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should OpenClaw keep the shipped systemd exit-78 lock-conflict behavior and close this exit-0 probe branch, or sponsor a rebased probe-based design for a remaining non-systemd/authenticated-gateway gap?
rationale: The central restart-loop symptom is already fixed in main and a release with a different exit-code contract, while this protected PR changes startup/auth semantics and still has correctness and proof blockers.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Keep the shipped exit-78 behavior as the product direction and close this conflicted branch rather than reviving the exit-0 probe design.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Probe Refresh
options.body: Ask for a rebase that preserves only a proven remaining gap, fixes trusted-proxy source validation and IPv6 URLs, removes unrelated churn, and adds real supervisor proof.

options.title: Accept Exit-0 Probe Semantics
options.body: Explicitly choose exit-0 healthy-probe semantics despite the compatibility, security-boundary, and availability tradeoffs, then require upgrade and real-behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Keep the shipped exit-78 behavior as the product direction and close this conflicted branch rather than reviving the exit-0 probe design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current shipped exit-78 implementation that this branch would replace or extend.
